method: The eight open questions were presented with options, consequences and a recommended value grounded in rendering §4.1 and ADR-0010; the owner selected one option per question in a direct decision request. No value was inferred from a blanket implementation permission.

selections.question: Linked transform model and default
selections.selected: 相対フィットを既定にし、等倍1:1を明示モードとして持つ
selections.ratified_value: relative-to-fit default (shared normalized anchor + multiplier over each pane contain-fit); physical 1:1 as a separate explicit mode

selections.question: Fit/1:1 switching
selections.selected: 既定Fit、明示操作で1:1、アンカー保持
selections.ratified_value: default Fit; explicit per-pair control switches to physical 1:1 and preserves the shared anchor

selections.question: Swap semantics
selections.selected: 候補のみ入替、変形は保持
selections.ratified_value: swap exchanges candidates only; each pane keeps its transform and re-clamps

selections.question: Link state on pair replacement
selections.selected: Link維持、置換側のみFit初期化
selections.ratified_value: pair replacement keeps the link and resets only the replaced pane to Fit

selections.question: Unlink restore
selections.ratified_value: unlink keeps the current display; no hidden restore or jump

selections.question: Pane keyboard/focus order
selections.selected: A→B→操作→一覧、Swapでもペイン固定
selections.ratified_value: Tab order pane A -> pane B -> compare actions -> candidate list; pane focus survives Swap; a missing side returns focus to the list

selections.question: Unavailable and limited-preview wording
selections.ratified_value: per-state explicit wording: unavailable with reason, bounded preview labelled low-resolution, clipped regions stated; never call a preview full detail

selections.question: Same-key reuse visibility
selections.ratified_value: reuse visibility in diagnostics only; sharing benefit NOT_MEASURED

derived.Q7: The anchor mapping follows the ratified Q5 model: fit_i = min(view_w/image_w, view_h/image_h), display scale fit_i x z, independent per-pane clamp and no clamped-anchor feedback.

unchanged: Q1-Q4 and Q11 keep their ADR-0010 values
Viewed stays Desktop-local; Formal Selected stays Runtime-owned; Compare stays non-canonical

boundaries.implementation: No product source changed for this decision; Compare remains DESIGN_READY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED until MP-CMP1 implements the ratified values.
boundaries.acceptance: Owner ratification is a design decision, not implementation, measurement or product acceptance.
boundaries.gate: Documentation-only change; no Refine Gate applies (ADR-0014 Y04).
